name: TestSprite 2.0
description: An AI-powered testing agent and automation platform designed for AI-native teams. Provides end-to-end software testing with autonomous test plan building, code writing for tests, test execution, debugging, and automated reporting with minimal human input. The 2.0 version introduces the industry's first MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for testing, enabling AI assistants in IDEs to automatically validate AI-generated code and help solve the AI code quality crisis.

name: OpenCode
description: An open-source AI coding agent built for terminal, IDE, or desktop environments. Supports 75+ different model providers including Claude, OpenAI, Google, or local models, allowing developers to use their preferred AI model directly in their workflow. Features terminal-based interface, desktop app, and IDE extension with multi-session functionality, diff viewing, and git integration.

name: GoCodeo
description: A full-stack AI development platform that transforms product requirements (PRDs) directly into deployable applications inside your IDE.
